objectives: Decide whether a property bought during a marriage is common property or personal property.
Decide who must sign when a married person sells real estate, and what happens if one spouse signs alone.
Explain the form and the entry of a marriage contract.
Explain when the district court must permit a disposal of a child's property.
Prepare a parental consent for a child to travel abroad.

cards.front: Name the three matrimonial property regimes.
cards.back: Statutory community, statutory separation, contractual regime (Art. 18 СК).

cards.front: Which regime applies when the spouses chose none?
Where are marriage contracts and regimes registered?
cards.back: In the **central electronic register** at the Registry Agency (Art. 19 СК).

cards.front: Georgi sold his premarital flat and bought a new one during the marriage with all that money. Whose is the new flat?
cards.back: **Personal**, when acquired entirely with personal money (Art. 23(1) СК). The deed usually states the origin of the money and the other spouse's confirmation; otherwise joint contribution is presumed (Art. 21(3)).

cards.front: Name three kinds of personal property.
cards.back: Acquired before the marriage; by inheritance or gift; with entirely personal money (Art. 22–23 СК).

cards.front: The husband sold a common flat alone. What may the wife do?
cards.back: Sue to challenge the sale within **6 months** of learning of it, and at most **3 years** after it (Art. 24(4) СК).

cards.front: When does the sale of a personal family home need the other spouse's consent?
cards.back: When the spouses have **no other home** (Art. 26 СК).

cards.front: Shares of spouses when the community ends?

cards.back: Signed **personally**, in writing, with notarial certification of **content and signatures** (Art. 39(1) СК).

cards.front: A marriage contract signed in May transfers a flat; the wedding is in July. When is it entered?
cards.back: On the day the notary receives the **marriage certificate** (Art. 39(3) СК; Art. 25(5) ЗННД). It takes effect from the marriage (Art. 40).

cards.front: What can a marriage contract NOT contain?
cards.back: Dispositions in case of death; a clause making premarital property common (Art. 38 СК).

cards.front: What needs court permission for a child's property?
cards.back: Disposals of real estate, of movables by formal deal, of deposits and securities (Art. 130(3) СК).

cards.front: Can one parent alone represent a child?
cards.back: **Yes**, in the child's interest; with a conflict of interest, a special representative is appointed (Art. 129 СК).

cards.front: What document allows a child to travel abroad with one parent?
cards.back: A **declaration of consent** of the other parent; the act names no form (Art. 76 ЗБЛД), and the border authorities ask for a **notarially certified signature**. Disputes go to the district court (Art. 127а СК).

quiz.question: Spouses married in 2012. In 2021 the husband bought a house in his name with his salary. Who must sign a sale of the house?
options: Both spouses
Only the husband
Only the husband, with a declaration
The wife alone
quiz.explanation: Art. 21(1) СК: a right acquired during the marriage through joint contribution is common, whoever's name is in the deed, and the contribution is presumed (Art. 21(3)); a salary is such a contribution. Disposal of common property is made by both spouses together (Art. 24(3)).

quiz.question: A wife inherited a flat from her mother during the marriage. Who owns it?
options: The wife personally
Both spouses equally
The wife and her siblings always
The husband
quiz.explanation: Art. 22(1) СК: rights acquired during the marriage by inheritance or gift are personal property of the spouse who acquired them. The siblings inherit only if they are heirs under the Inheritance Act.

quiz.question: A husband sold a common apartment alone in January 2025. The wife learned in March 2026. Until when may she sue?
options: Until September 2026
Until January 2028
Until March 2031
Never; the sale is final
quiz.explanation: Art. 24(4) СК: the other spouse may challenge the disposal within six months of learning of it, and no later than three years after it. Six months from March 2026 end in September 2026; the three years from January 2025 would end in January 2028, later, so the shorter term applies.

quiz.question: A woman owns a flat from before the marriage. It is the only home of the family. She wants to sell it. What is required?
options: The consent of her husband, or a permission of the district judge
Nothing; the flat is her personal property from before the marriage
A marriage contract that names the flat as personal
The written consent of the adult children who live in the flat
quiz.explanation: Art. 26 СК: a spouse disposes of a family home that is personal property only with the consent of the other spouse, when the spouses have no other home; without consent, the district judge may permit the disposal. Children never consent.

quiz.question: Can a fiancé sign a marriage contract through a power of attorney?
options: No; the parties sign personally
Yes, with a notarised power of attorney
Yes, if the other party agrees to it
Yes, at a Bulgarian consulate abroad
quiz.explanation: Art. 39(1) СК: the marriage contract is concluded personally by the parties, in writing with notarial certification of the content and the signatures. A consul cannot help a party who is absent; the party must appear.

quiz.question: A couple signed a marriage contract in May that transfers a flat from one partner to the other. They marry in July. When is the contract entered?
options: On the day the notary receives the marriage certificate
In May, on the day of the signing, like any deed
Within one month after the wedding, by the spouses
It is not entered; the contract is private
quiz.explanation: Art. 39(3) СК with Art. 25(5) ЗННД: a marriage contract with a transfer of real estate concluded before the marriage is presented for entry on the day the notary receives the certificate of civil marriage; the contract takes effect from the marriage (Art. 40).

quiz.question: Which clause is NOT allowed in a marriage contract?
options: Who inherits the flat after the death of a spouse
Separate ownership of the salaries of the spouses
Maintenance between the spouses after a divorce
Management of the family home during the marriage
quiz.explanation: Art. 38(3) СК: a marriage contract may not contain dispositions in case of death; the only exception concerns the shares of the spouses at the end of an agreed community. Salaries, maintenance and the family home are property arrangements allowed by Art. 38(1).

quiz.question: Parents want to sell an apartment that belongs to their 12-year-old daughter. What do they need?
options: Permission of the district court of the child's address
Nothing; the parents represent the child in every deal
The written consent of the child, who is older than ten years
A permission of the municipality where the flat is
quiz.explanation: Art. 130(3) СК: a disposal of a child's real estate needs the permission of the district court of the child's current address, given when the disposal is not against the child's interest. The parents represent the child (Art. 129) but cannot replace the permission.

quiz.question: A 17-year-old wants to waive his share of an inheritance in favour of his mother. What is the legal position?
options: A waiver of rights by a minor is void
Valid with the consent of a parent
Valid with the permission of the court
Valid if the minor understands it
quiz.explanation: Art. 130(4) СК: a gift, a waiver of rights, a loan and a security for another's debt by a minor are void; no consent or permission cures them. A renunciation of an inheritance is such a waiver (chapter 13).

quiz.question: A mother and her 10-year-old son inherited a house and want to divide it. What is needed for the son?
options: A special representative and the permission of the court
The mother signs for both, as the legal representative
The father signs alone, in the name of the child
Nothing special; a partition is not a disposal
quiz.explanation: Art. 129(2) СК: when the interests of a parent and the child conflict, as in a partition between them, a special representative is appointed; Art. 130(3) adds the court's permission for the disposal of the child's real estate. A partition is a disposal.

quiz.question: A child will travel to Greece with the mother. What does the father sign?
options: A declaration of consent with a certified signature
A notarial deed of consent for the travel
Nothing; one parent is enough for a trip
A power of attorney with certified content
quiz.explanation: Art. 76 item 9 ЗБЛД: a minor may be refused exit without the consent of the parents; the act names no form, and in practice the border authorities ask for a declaration with a notarially certified signature (item 5(a) of the tariff). A deed or a power with certified content is not required.

quiz.question: No property regime of a couple is entered in the register. A buyer buys from the husband. Which regime may the buyer rely on?
options: The statutory community
The statutory separation
The regime the husband declares
No regime; the buyer must ask the court
quiz.explanation: Art. 20 СК: when no regime is entered in the register, a third person may rely on the statutory community, so the buyer needs both spouses' signatures (Art. 24(3)). The husband's declaration does not change the regime.
